chapter: Chicago clubs, entertainers and tent shows
title: The death of Princess White on stage at 95
summary: Cheatham was at the concert near Larchmont where Princess White sang Peeping Through the Keyhole, said she felt tired, and died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Princess White just died, didn't she?
Yes, she died just -- I was on that concert when she died.
Yes. Yes, we had a concert up in New York state somewhere, outside of Larchmont.
And she died right after singing her two songs.
She was about -- well she was in her 80's.
Well she sang very well. She sang all of her songs, the last song was 'Peeping Through the Keyhole.' That was the last song, she sang it without any prob-

lem at all. And she finished singing and said she -- she was very well received and she told her audience today I'm 95 years old and says I feel a little tired, I have a lot of butterflies in my stomach and she walked off the stage, sat down and died.
